title: Chapter 163 Ambush
content:
Chapter 163 Ambush

Wang Shuo led his troops to the foot of Mount Wadang and quickly dealt with the first sentry.

With Guliji's reconnaissance, they did not alert the enemy, but captured them all alive.

From the foot of the mountain, there is a narrow path about 2 meters wide, just a few hundred meters up.

On one side is a steep cliff, and on the other side is a 3-meter-high cliff. There are lush vegetation on the mountain, which is suitable for hiding ambushes.

After surveying the terrain nearby, Wang Shuo chose to ambush on this must-pass road.

After the bandits pass through, they can build fortifications to cut off the bandits' retreat.

On the opposite side of the cliff, on a small hill with a wide view, Wang Shuo ordered people to level the land and let the three brothers Li Jianguo, with 20 soldiers who have not yet changed their jobs, control 4 bronze crossbow carts.

Provide long-range firepower support to the front battlefield of the ambush site. Because there is a gully more than 100 meters wide in the middle, the bandits cannot pose a threat to the crossbow cart position.

Wang Shuo only sent these 20 soldiers of the lowest level to fill the spears and assist in the attack.

In addition, the shield is an indispensable defensive weapon, and it is also necessary to defend against the bandits' bows and arrows.

Before Wang Shuo set out, he equipped everyone with a shield and a bow and arrow.

At this time, Wang Shuo was really grateful to the blacksmith shop. If he had not been well-equipped, he would not have the confidence to come here to ambush the bandits.

Everything is ready, and now the most important thing is missing.

That is how to lead the bandits down the mountain.

Wang Shuo already had a plan for this.

He came to the captured bandits, holding a shining long sword in his hand, and carefully looked at the bandits.

"What's your name?" Wang Shuo asked loudly.

"Jiang Yingyu." The bandit answered tremblingly, and his speech was a little unclear.

"Speak English?" Wang Shuo frowned, surprised!

Are the bandits so awesome now? They can even speak English?

"I asked you what your name is. You don't look like a foreigner, so why do you speak English?" Wang Shuo's eyes flashed with a cold light, as if he was going to kill someone if he disagreed with someone.

"My name is Jiang Yingyu."

The bandit was so scared that he trembled all over and hurriedly explained, full of desire to survive.

"I have a scroll here, you sign it for me!"

Wang Shuo took out the "Thought Stamp" scroll and threw it to him.

The other party signed it without hesitation.

Are all bandits so afraid of death?

Wang Shuo was still thinking about how to coerce and lure this bandit to rebel, but he didn't expect that the other party signed the scroll without any effort.

This made Wang Shuo feel like he had punched a cotton ball.

After the contract came into effect, Jiang Yingyu's attitude changed immediately and he was no longer timid.

After Wang Shuo explained a few words to him, Gong Zheng took a few people and took the golden treasure chest that Wang Shuo had opened before, which was full of gold coins, and walked towards the mountain together.

Looking at the people going away, Wang Shuo sighed: "I don't know if it's worth wasting a scroll!"

This time, he made two preparations. If the bandits can go down the mountain, he will charge with cavalry in the plains. If the bandits don't go down the mountain, he will ambush them here.

Qingmu Village.

Zhang Wenlong, the boss, was furious when he saw the remnants of the bandits fleeing back.

He picked up the wine bowl, suddenly stood up from the tiger-skin chair, drank the wine in the bowl, and threw the wine bowl to the ground with a "smack".

"I'm so angry! I'm going to take people to flatten Wana Village."

He glared and roared angrily.
